patterns.name: Sliding Window
patterns.description: Maintain a window of elements and slide it through the array
patterns.template:
def sliding_window_template(arr, k):
    window_sum = sum(arr[:k])
    max_sum = window_sum
    
    for i in range(k, len(arr)):
        # Slide window: remove leftmost, add rightmost
        window_sum = window_sum - arr[i - k] + arr[i]
        max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
    
    return max_sum

patterns.name: Fast & Slow Pointers
patterns.description: Use two pointers moving at different speeds
patterns.template:
def fast_slow_pointers(head):
    slow = fast = head
    
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
        
        if slow == fast:  # Cycle detected
            return True
    
    return False

def tree_dfs(root):
    if not root:
        return
    
    # Pre-order: Process current node first
    result.append(root.val)
    tree_dfs(root.left)
    tree_dfs(root.right)
    
    # In-order: Process left, current, right
    # Post-order: Process children first, then current

patterns.name: Tree BFS
Dynamic Programming
patterns.description: Break problem into subproblems and store results
patterns.template:
def dp_template(n):
    # 1. Define state: dp[i] = optimal solution for subproblem i
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    # 2. Base case
    dp[0] = base_value
    
    # 3. State transition
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i] = min/max(dp[i-1] + cost[i], dp[i-2] + cost[i])
    
    return dp[n]
